newsitem.title: UK: Clean tanker chartering rates little changed.
newsitem.headline: Clean tanker chartering rates little changed.

text.p: Clean tanker chartering rates were little changed on Friday for most sizes and routes, shipbrokers said.
The fixture by an unknown charter of the 55,000 tonne Action Express from the Mideast to Japan at W137.5 was seen broadly representative of rates.

"Several fixtures were reported (this week) at the very low level of W100 for the 50,000 tonne size from the Red Sea for discharge in Singapore/Japan but with the dissipation of available spot tonnage, the market remains hopeful that rate levels will be reestablished at somewhere in the W130s.
Cross-med rates for naphtha were illustrated by Elf's fixture of the 24,000 tonne Voltri from Skikda at W177.5. Brokers said this roughly represented the market.
Rates for 30,000 tonnes moving from the Caribs to upcoast U.S. were perhaps slightly weaker and were assessed somewhere beneath the W240 paid for recent ships.
Cross-UKCont rates for 22,000 tonners were also flat at around W200.
